name: io.github.jaiakash/kai-mcp-server
title: KAI — Kubernetes AI Agent
description: Kubernetes as MCP tools: policy guardrails, RBAC pre-flight, server-side dry run, read-only default.

runtimeArguments.name: --volume
runtimeArguments.description: Mount a kubeconfig into the container. KAI reads the cluster with these credentials and never writes to the file.

kubeconfig_path.description: Absolute path to your kubeconfig on the host.

packageArguments.name: --transport
packageArguments.description: MCP transport. Use stdio when the host launches the server itself.

environmentVariables.name: KAI_ALLOW_WRITES
environmentVariables.description: Register the mutating tools. Off by default: KAI is read-only unless you ask otherwise. Writes still default to a server-side dry run, and protected namespaces stay read-only.

environmentVariables.name: KAI_DRY_RUN_ONLY
environmentVariables.description: Force every permitted write to execute as a server-side dry run, so the agent can propose changes a human applies.

environmentVariables.name: KAI_ALLOWED_NAMESPACES
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated namespace allowlist. When set, every action must target one of these namespaces and cluster-scoped actions are refused.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer token issued by your own identity provider. KAI has no authentication of its own; a shared deployment is fronted by agentgateway, which verifies the token and authorizes per tool.

hostname.description: Host of your agentgateway in front of KAI.
